items.t: Moderna Sinks 7% as Analyst Day Cancer Push Brings “$4 Billion in Cash Costs in 2027”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysModerna shares fell 7% today after the company guided to cash costs of about $4 billion in 2027 and $4 billion to $4. 5 billion a year through 2030, mostly for oncology.

items.t: Why Is Moderna (MRNA) Joining A Global Benchmark And Publishing New Vaccine Data?
items.sum: Moderna (NasdaqGS:MRNA) is scheduled to join the MSCI World Index in November 2026, which would add the stock to a major global benchmark. The biotech group reported publication of real world data on its mNEXSPIKE COVID-19 vaccine in older adults in a peer reviewed journal.
